title: Setting Austin's Budget and Goals
summary:
*   City leaders outlined budget priorities and strategic goals for the upcoming 1994-95 fiscal year.
*   Discussions centered on understanding external community issues and addressing citizen needs.
*   The meeting also focused on internal operational improvements and fostering teamwork among city officials.
